headline: Nvidia-backed data centre firm Firmus has closed its IPO order book a day early, as investors grew worried the listing could be pulled.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: the headline matches the Bloomberg text read; the AFR price figure adds doubt, noted in the summary.
importance_line: It tests investor appetite for big AI infrastructure listings, but the price is unclear and the Bloomberg and AFR accounts do not agree on it.
summary: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the deal, that Australian data centre company Firmus closed its order book a day early on Thursday, with the price and structure unclear, as investors worried the deal could be pulled. This follows our 6 Oct item that CDC ended its $73.3 billion data centre deal with Firmus; today the Australian Financial Review reports that bankers are working overnight to save the deal at about $8.25 a share, against the A$11 Bloomberg says was marketed.
